notes.title: Chinese update
notes.notes:
Hi, this is CreaTeam.

We noticed that our game has been crashing in China for the last week, so as a token of our gratitude we made an update with a normal, non-machine translation into Chinese.

Enjoy your poop!

notes.title: FINAL PATCH
RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Friends!
We are pleased to inform you that Code Brown has finally gone on sale, but this does not mean that development has come to an end. Unfortunately, there are still some cosmetic bugs that need to be fixed. But the gameplay and overall impression should not be affected.
We will try to fix it all out in the first patches. In the meantime, enjoy the game. We are waiting for your feedback. Also be sure to tell us about errors that you may have during the game.
Your CreaTeam.

notes.title: Postpone release date
notes.notes:
Dear friends! 
We sincerely apologize for having to postpone release date on November 9th. We miscalculated our abilities, and we need one more day to polish the game for playability condition. 
We hope that we will not disappoint you.
